## Rule

**Corpus-proven 200,000/200,000** (2026-06-07; study script + per-fact stats in session log):
input is always a single contiguous **vertical line of 7s anchored at row 0** (length
L ∈ 3..9, column c0 ∈ 2..7) on bg, grid H×W with H,W ∈ 5..10 uniform, L ≤ H always,
input colors exactly {0,7}. Output = **chevron** `r + |c−c0| ≤ L−1` clipped to the active
grid: color **7 where |c−c0| even, 8 where odd**, bg 0 elsewhere in-grid, zero outside.
(Organic framing: alternating-color diagonal rays up-left+up-right from every 7; the union
over a top-anchored vertical line is exactly the chevron.) Rows never clip (L ≤ H);
columns do clip (c0+L−1 can exceed W−1). LIVE class-check: **200k/200k = clean class**
(`Logs/task348_live_truth_full.json`).

## Algorithm sketch

```python
L = count(input == 7); c0 = argmax_c(colsum7)   # ties impossible: single line
T[c] = L - abs(c - c0)                          # per-column chevron height
out[r, c] = (7 + (abs(c-c0) % 2)) if r < T[c] else 0   # clipped to H×W
```

## Floor proof (formulation-relative, #68 discipline — 2026-06-07)

**Mechanism**: cost = memory(intermediates, max(static,observed)) + params; tensors named
`input`/`output` are skipped (§39, #67) — so the only lever is what exists BETWEEN them.

**Final-op enumeration** (every family that can write [1,10,30,30] from sub-output operands):
- **Equal-tail (chosen)**: u8 canvas [1,1,30,30] **900** + ids 10p. u8 = smallest Equal
  dtype carrying 11 values {0..9, sentinel}; BOOL can't (2 values), and any 30×30 canvas
  ≥ 900 B at 1 B/elem.
- Pad-final: pre-pad one-hot [1,10,10,10] BOOL 1,000 + code 100 = **+200 vs chosen**.
- Broadcast Add/Sum/Greater/GreaterOrEqual-final: needs per-channel column thresholds
  [1,10,1,30] F16 = 600 dynamic + assembly (~240 pads/concat) + row ramps [1,10,30,1]
  300p; the ch0 row-suffix `T[c] ≤ r < H` kills it: H is dynamic, so the row-kill term is
  either a [1,10,30,1] dynamic tensor (600 B) or a 2nd 2-D operand → **≥ ~1,460 B, all worse** (priced 2026-06-07).
- MatMul-final: per-channel masks have rank ≥ 2 → A [1,10,30,K≥2] F16 ≥ 1,200 dynamic. ✗
- OneHot-final: indices must be INT32/64 → [1,30,30] ≥ 3,600. ✗
- Conv/Resize-final: float spatial operand ≥ [·,·,30,30] ≥ 1,800 (+Resize has no zero-fill
  semantics for this). ✗  Where-final: cond [1,1,30,30] 900 + 2 one-hot branches ≥ +1,200. ✗
- Concat/Expand/Transpose/Cast/Identity-final: operand(s) ≥ output bytes. ✗
- Params-only single node (#68 addendum class): output is input-dependent. ✗

**Within Equal-tail, per-tensor minimums**: canvas 900 (above) + 3-value 10×10 code with
`active = rowact(r) ∧ colact(c)` — a 2-D-indexed 3-way split needs ≥ 2 chained u8 Where
[·,10,10] + 1 BOOL chevron mask [·,10,10] = 300 (single-Where forms can bind only one 2-D
selector; u8-arithmetic forms priced +20) + input marginals: c0/L live in ch7's column
marginal (needs the e7 selection ⇒ Einsum, #74), W/rowact in the all-channel rows
marginal (unweighted ⇒ plain ReduceL1, attr-axes, no selector init) — one op emits one
reduction, so 2 × 120 B F32 = 240 + scalar/vector/bool plumbing ~185 + params 68.
**v6 = 1,692 = 1,440 hard floor + 185 plumbing + 67 params**; remaining slack ≤ ~30 B
(scalar-cast and rab-slice shavings already taken in v3→v5; everything else enumerated
above). Target <30% of LIVE (2,952) beaten at **17.2%**.

**2026-06-24 code-plane parity-vector challenge:** the proposed single-membership-plane
replacement for the 300 B code stage was priced with `task348_codeplane_*_probe.onnx`.
The cheap form `Where(insideb, cvu8, 255)` scores **1538/profile 1538** but is invalid
(visible **0/265**) because outside-chevron active-grid cells must decode as background
0 while padding/out-of-grid cells must decode as all-false/no-color. The corrected form
`Where(activeb, Where(insideb, cvu8, 0), 255)` restores correctness (visible **265/265**)
but scores **1782/profile 1782**: it keeps the 900 B canvas and 240 B marginals, then
charges four 100 B code planes (`insideb`, `color_or_bg`, `activeb`, `code`) instead of
v6's three (`insideb`, `base`, `code`). Result: **+90 vs v6**, so the parity-vector
single-membership route does not break the Equal-tail code-stage floor.

**2026-06-21 fresh floor challenge:** the archived free-output separable-Einsum prompt was
priced with `task348_freeeinsum_probe.onnx`. It passes visible 265/265, but costs
**3,819** (profile 3,819): deleting the 900 B U8 canvas requires `[11]` term stacks
(`rterms`, `cterms`, `kterms`) plus 604 params, so the charge moves upstream and loses.
The useful trim from this pass is instead v6's `Greater(rcv,0)` → `Cast(rcv→BOOL)`,
which keeps the ABI/static shape and removes one scalar param.

**2026-06-21 W16 independent live re-verification (WALL re-confirmed):** re-measured the
staged best directly — `task348_rcv_castbool_cost1692/task348.onnx` scores `_score_v2`
**1692** (mem 1625 + params 67), profile `--arcgen 266` **static=1692 == profile=1692**

## Don't-do log

- **Don't crop the full 10-channel grid** (LIVE's 8,000 B mistake) — only ch7's column
  marginal + active marginals are consumed; free-input einsum gets them for 120 B each.
- **Don't restructure to cols-marginal-for-H** (colcount→H scalar, rowact = Less(rowidx,H),
  Min-clip vs cc10): priced **1,787 > 1,708** — the cc10 Slice+Cast chain costs more than
  rab/rab10 (measured 2026-06-07, not an estimate).
- **Don't chase broadcast-Add/Sum/Greater finals** — the dynamic H row-kill forces ≥1,460 B
  (see floor proof). Same for Pad-final (+200), Max(rbase,cbase) base (+10), u8-arithmetic
  act mask (+20).
- **Don't retry the u8 comparison-final either** (Greater(B[1,10,1,30]u8, A[1,10,30,1]u8),
  operands 300+300): assembling per-channel content (dyn ch0 + static ch7/ch8 + dead) into
  A/B needs Concat-with-static-planes (≥210 params) or 3 stacked [1,10,1,30] Where planes
  (900 B) — re-derived and killed 2026-06-07 ping-2.
- **Don't generate index vectors with Range**: output memory (40 B) + 3 scalar params >
  10-param init. Init wins for anything ≤ ~30 elements.
- **cols-marginal restructure stays dead under ReduceL1 too**: re-priced +30 vs v5 (the
  ccv10 Slice+Cast chain 60 B > rab+rab10 40 B; H-vs-W scalar extraction is a wash).
- **Don't fear these kernels** (all probed/gated green at opset 14, 2026-06-07):
  `Mod(F16,fmod=1)` exact on 0..9; `Where(bool,u8,u8)`; `Pad(u8)`; `Equal(u8→BOOL)` output;
  `Xor`; `Cast(I32→BOOL)`; `ReduceL1(F32)` attr-axes; Einsum forms `bchw,c->bw` and
  `bchw,cv->bhv` (rank-3 out, reshape-free row-vector broadcasting).
- **Don't use Einsum for UNWEIGHTED reductions** — plain ReduceL1/ReduceSum charges the
  same output bytes and needs no selector init (v4→v5: −10 params; einsum is only forced
  where a channel SELECTION rides the reduction, like cs7's e7).
- **ArgMax tie-handling is a non-issue**: corpus has exactly one 7-column in all 200k pairs.
- v1↔v5 differ only in dtype/plumbing — if any F16/Mod/ReduceL1 concern arises, ship v3
  (1,708, INT32-Mod + einsum-only) or v1 (1,987, all-F32 vectors); all five rungs
  byte-equal vs LIVE on 200k+265.
